name: codemap-boost-codex
description: Install-ready CodeMap workflow for Codex using a bundled code-review-graph MCP, synchronized graph refresh barriers, and AGENTS.md instructions.

interface.shortDescription: Nudge Codex toward code-review-graph for code structure work.
interface.longDescription: Loads code-review-graph as a bundled MCP with an isolated runtime, maintains a bounded AGENTS.md block, and synchronizes graph reads after source changes. Structural prompts and subagents receive concise retrieval guidance; ordinary shell searches do not inject routing instructions. Known files and literal text can be read directly, with source inspection available when graph coverage is insufficient.
defaultPrompt: Set up CodeMap Boost for this Codex environment.
